slot_scores.name: single_vehicle_per_customer
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are there any additional constraints or requirements beyond the capacity limit, time windows, and depot return that I should include in the model?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never explicitly asked whether a customer's demand may be split across vehicles. The only related question was a vague catch-all about additional constraints, which does not target the single-vehicle-per-customer rule.

slot_scores.name: depot_return_requirement
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Do all trucks start at the depot at time 0 and must they return to the depot after completing their route?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether trucks must return to the depot after completing their route, matching the slot's key meaning.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Each customer is served by exactly one truck (no split deliveries), as implied by the VRPTW formulation with a subset assignment per truck.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked whether split deliveries were allowed, yet declared 'No Additional Constraints' and 'Assumptions: None', silently adopting the single-vehicle-per-customer interpretation.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while P1 slot H1 (single vehicle per customer / no split deliveries) remained unresolved; it declared no assumptions without confirming this core business rule.

summary: The agent confirmed the depot-return rule but never clarified whether customer demand can be split across vehicles, then stopped with a 'no assumptions' READY_TO_MODEL, leaving a P1 business rule silently assumed.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
